subject: Scoring handoff complete; PA identity location and queued checkpoints
body:
Checkpoint: both Meta Mirror AI Studio maps are complete and saved, Prime 93/93 lines and MM_1 103/103 on independent timebases. Prime remains master. Three section-boundary intervals are withheld from the provisional map; no timing, lip-sync or scene acceptance. The local listening review and three new document registrations are built. Source/review hashes and all 50 unset scene timings are preserved. Current collection/compact browsing checks passed; two mission tests stop at an outdated test-harness literal, before library execution. Local HTML visual preview was policy-blocked; static checks passed.

The existing first-clip launch permission is recognized. The exact patch-c source decision remains the question recorded in 6a36ba15-2107-422e-bfc1-f154bf95e793: changed geography/wardrobe and jewelry discrepancies. Route-specific first-frame mode/model and per-clip quote remain before Start. No additional video was generated.

Acknowledged reference-validation-evidence-ui-20261013. Keep its existing queue position behind the scoring/content handoff. First implementation checkpoint: current review/storage snapshot and serialization/import/export audit, then additive evidence-sidecar design with preservation/rollback checks. No duplicate assignment or legacy automatic passes.

Confirm PA's separate identity/nova_personal_assistant/I_AM.md under collaborators. PA owns its dated self-authored text; CFA Nova maintains registry metadata. Register actual path/hash/bytes, dates and reply provenance when supplied; keep currentIntroduction null until then. CFA Nova and Panhandler Nova stay distinct.

For 83a3b059: MD-LAG-SW-001 is a suitable first proposal (LAG-SC-09 to 10; SW-1/SW-2, optional SW-4/SW-5). Recommend Claude refine the creative target within his writer role, CFA retain intake/execution, Ziggy choose music/style/lyrics. The 60-90s design and exact source versions remain proposed; add hashes when nominated. No Suno submission or master rewrite. DeepSeek's attributed image-specific response is acknowledged; source pixels/surface and accuracy remain uncalibrated. No new activation.
